title: settings: a2a
description: A2A facade settings, owned by the agents component. The facade serves published agents to A2A clients through the shared gateway; it is off unless enabled and binds loopback only.

enabled.description: Serve the facade. Off by default.

port.description: Loopback port the facade listens on.

base_url.description: The origin clients use to reach the facade, put in Agent Cards: an HTTPS origin served by a TLS reverse proxy, or http://127.0.0.1:PORT. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

projects.description: Gateway project ids to serve. Every agent published to A2A in the machine-global catalog is served in each.
